title: Triple X Group Emerges
description: Ransomware group Triple X first observed establishing leak infrastructure on Tor.

title: Triple X Hits BNI (Indonesia)
description: First known victim: Bank Negara Indonesia. ~2 TB of customer data allegedly exfiltrated from the state-owned bank.

title: BNI Breach Published
description: Triple X publishes BNI breach details. Sample data posted including passports and ID cards.

title: Triple X Added to WatchGuard Tracker
description: Ransomware monitoring services track Triple X as a new active threat group with data broker variant classification.

title: Triple X Claims Bank of Baroda Breach
description: Group lists BoB on its leak site, claiming ~1 TB of data exfiltrated. Claims 'weak password' as initial access vector.

title: BoB Dump Server Goes Live
description: Full recursive directory of 15,774+ files published on Tor onion service. CKYC records, VAPT reports, admin credentials, international ops data all exposed.

title: Server Intermittent / Returns Online
description: BoB dump server briefly goes offline, then returns. Threat intel community amplifies via X/Twitter. CashlessConsumer verifies dump server.

title: Full OSINT Investigation Launched
description: CashlessConsumer begins comprehensive crawl (995s, 925 HTTP fetches, 0 errors). 92,347 file entries cataloged across L5 inventory. Deep-dive intelligence report drafted.

title: CBI Legal Docs Confirmed in Dump
description: CBI FIR #RC2192025E0004 confirmed among leaked files. Legal notices, customer confirmations, Hitachi vendor docs retrieved (63 MB).

title: Customer PII Exposure Confirmed
description: 178 MB of KYC data including eKYC dumps, LFAR KYC lists, ReKYC notices, DBT BSBD accounts retrieved from the dump server.

title: bobbreach.cashlessconsumer.in Launched
description: Consumer-facing portal launched to help customers check if their branch was impacted and understand next steps.
